label: SIMULATION
limitations: SIMULATION: daily arrivals are synthetic; only monthly section totals are REAL.
Filling stations are 90 stand-ins placed where bookings cluster; HMWSSB publishes no station list.
Replay bookings carry no tier, so tier 0/1 priority is not exercised.
Scheduled supply treats every A2 candidate as officer-confirmed.
Need weights use Census 2011 shares (E2); groups without a ward use the median.
Km are straight-line x road factor plus an in-section access distance, not roads.

policies.B1: FCFS at the nearest filling station (HMWSSB today)
policies.B2: Nearest bookings first at each station
policies.B3: Section with most pending bookings first
policies.B4: Minimum cost: stations pooled, cheapest trips first
